text:
sam (support): FYI inbound escalation — multiple customers reporting intermittent 5xx and timeouts hitting the hosted /v1/generate endpoint starting ~10:12 UTC. Error mix: 502, 504, and occasional 500. Affected regions: us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Customer sample request-id: req_3a9f2b1. Raising war room.

deploy-bot: new incident created: INCIDENT-1998 — Hosted API 5xx spike (us-east-1 / eu-west-1). Pager notified.

mia (oncall): Thanks @sam. Are we seeing any deploys around that time? @devin can you pull metrics (5xx rate, latency p95) and traffic split by model?

devin (sre): Pulling now. Quick numbers: 5xx rate spiked from ~0.1% to 3.8% in us-east-1 between 10:10 and 10:20. p95 latency jumped from 220ms to ~1.8s. CPU on inference-hosts climbed to 85-92% on several pools running long-context requests. No deploys in the last 2 hours according to deploy log.

jordan (runtime): Observed a backlog in the batching queue for several model variants (gptx-2-16k and opt-rl). Queue depth climbed and KV cache memory pressure caused frequent chunked GC pauses. Patch idea: temporarily lower max_seq for those instances to reduce KV contention.

lee (oncall): Are these customer requests common (long tokens) or some bad client loop?

sam (support): Some customers reported large single requests ~12-15k tokens (context windows). Also a spike of retrying clients hitting gateway timeouts and hammering retries.

devin (sre): Repro curl from customer (sanitized):

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -d '{"model":"gptx-2-16k","input":"<very long prompt...>","max_tokens":1024}'
```

Response observed: repeated 504 gateway timeout after ~30s. Gateway logs show upstream connection resets from runtime pool.

jordan (runtime): Runtime logs snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T10:13:21Z] inference-node-12: KVCache::evict_chunk  size=245MB free=120MB
[2026-03-15T10:13:22Z] inference-node-12: batch_queue.length=187 target=32
[2026-03-15T10:13:23Z] inference-node-12: request_id=req_3a9f2b1 status=timeout upstream_reset
```

mia (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can try:
- throttle long-sequence requests at the gateway (temporary rule)
- increase burst capacity for affected runtime pools (scale up)
- enable early 429 backpressure for overloaded hosts
- notify customers with interim guidance (avoid >8k single requests while we investigate)

devin (sre): Doing the following now: scaled dedicated pool +20% in us-east-1, added ephemeral nodes in eu-west-1. Pushing a temp gateway rule to reject requests with input length >9000 with 429 and Retry-After 30s.

sam (support): Posting a quick customer message template in support channel and sending to top 5 affected accounts. Will include suggested mitigation (split context, incremental calls).

analytics-bot: Alert: anomaly detected — retry storm in gateway layer correlated with spike in 5xx (see /dash/hosted/5xx-spike).

devin (sre): After scale up + gateway rule, 5xx rate dropped to 0.6% in 12min and latency p95 back to ~280ms. Still seeing some tail failures from eu-west-1, but overall improving.

jordan (runtime): Root cause hypothesis: long-context requests (>=10k tokens) cause large KV cache pressure and uneven batching, which led to queue blowups on a subset of hosts. Those hosts then returned upstream resets which the gateway turned into 5xx/504 for clients doing synchronous waits. Also retries from clients amplified the effect.

lee (oncall): Agree. Also noticed a config drift: a config change last week increased per-host batch window from 20ms->40ms for throughput. That change increases outstanding KV entries and likely amplified memory pressure under long contexts.

mia (oncall): Action items (initial):
- jordan: revert or reduce batch window on affected runtimes to 20ms (owner: jordan, ETA: 4h)
- devin: add an auto-scaler policy threshold for queue_depth > 100 to spin up nodes (owner: devin, ETA: 24h)
- eng-runtime: add guardrail to gateway to default reject >12k token single inputs for hosted tier and return helpful guidance (owner: jordan, ETA: 48h)
- support: send customer follow-ups + webhook with mitigation steps (owner: sam, ETA: 2h)
- docs: update best-practice doc for long-context usage (owner: product-docs, ETA: 3 days)
- oncall: add a runbook section for this pattern (owner: mia, ETA: 48h)

sam (support): I'll post the customer message after devin confirms stability window (30min).

devin (sre): Confirming stability. Scheduling a retrospective meeting at 16:00 UTC to draft a short postmortem. Creating ticket INF-4721 to track follow-ups.

jordan (runtime): I'll open a PR with the batch-window revert + test harness that simulates long-context queue behavior. Patch will include a knob for max_seq-per-host and a soft-failure path returning 429 when host is overloaded.

mia (oncall): Postmortem notes to capture:
- timeline of events (first spike, mitigations, stabilization)
- root cause analysis (batch window + long-context KV pressure + retry amplification)
- why the circuit-breaker/backpressure didn't trigger earlier
- customer impact and communications
- short/medium/long term actions & owners

sam (support): Templated customer update posted: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx/timeouts affecting hosted generate in US/EU. We've applied temporary throttles for very large requests and increased capacity. We're sorry for the disruption — support will follow up with affected accounts." Will link the postmortem when available.

devin (sre): Follow-ups created: INF-4721 (autoscale guard), INF-4722 (gateway long-input guard), INF-4723 (batch-window revert + tests). I'll add owners and due dates.

analytics-bot: Dashboard snapshot: 5xx spike peak 3.8% -> current 0.4%. CPU on affected pool back to ~62%.

lee (oncall): Thanks team. If things regress, ping this thread and escalate to SRE lead.

jordan (runtime): PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/1987 (WIP) — includes unit tests and stress script to reproduce queue overflow.

mia (oncall): Closing war room in 2h if metrics stable. We'll reconvene for the postmortem at 16:00 UTC. Thanks everyone for fast responses. :heart:

sam (support): Closing loop with customers who reported. Marking this incident as 'mitigated' for now.

deploy-bot: incident INCIDENT-1998 status changed to MITIGATED by mia (oncall).
